steps.what: Show the request already logged for this system.
Communicate with staff or clients to understand specific system requirements.

tasks.design: The {HELPDESK} shows the request already logged. The systems engineer talks with staff or clients to understand the specific system requirements. The logged request does not hold that conversation. A request with no caller leaves the screen blank, and the engineer asks in the room.
tasks.previous_blocker: The requirement was repeated in a meeting because the ticket only had a title.
tasks.enabler_now: The logged request can be opened. Understanding it still takes the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A client who cannot name the constraint still has to be heard.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer hears the requirement. The ticket is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The conversation stays with the staff or the client. The logged request is visible and is not treated as the requirement.

reach.task: Write a change for a requirement someone has confirmed.
reach.learn: A ticket title is not the requirement.

evidence.claim: Opening a logged request is a lookup of a title already written. It does not understand the requirement.
A stored summary is not the conversation with the person who uses the system.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The request id only if it is already logged. Requirements are not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the request on the service desk before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether clients and staff use the same request form.
research_questions: Who is in the room when the requirement is still unclear?

already_counted.description: The conversation about requirements stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop requests whose conversation has already happened.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still talks with staff or clients until the specific system requirements are understood. Only opening a request that was already logged is removed. A request with no caller saves none of the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the component record already stored for this purpose.
Investigate suitability and make recommendations regarding component use.
File the accepted recommendation for that component.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the component record already held. The systems engineer investigates suitability for the specified purpose and writes the recommendation. The record is filed only after the engineer accepts that version. A component with no stored purpose is not given a recommendation by the screen.
tasks.previous_blocker: The recommendation sat in a mailbox, and a later reader could not tell which component it named.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored component record can be opened. The recommendation still has to be written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a component will fit a purpose the record does not describe stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer investigates and recommends. The screen does not choose the component.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation stays with the engineer. Filing happens only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Choose a component for a network that is already described.
reach.learn: A catalogue row is not the recommendation.

evidence.claim: Showing a stored component record is a lookup. It does not judge suitability or write the recommendation.
Filing a recommendation before the engineer accepts that version would store a choice nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The component id and the purpose already stored on it. A blank purpose is not filled in. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the component record in the document store before building a second list.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether the purpose on the record is still the purpose the client named.
research_questions: Who accepts a recommendation when the engineer is not the buyer?

already_counted.description: Investigating suitability and writing the recommendation stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Retire recommendations whose component record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: recommendation version and the component id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still investigates suitability and still writes the recommendation. Only opening a stored component record, and filing the version the engineer has already accepted, is removed. A blank purpose saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write guidelines for a secure system.

steps.what: Draft guidelines for implementing secure systems from held control sentences.

loop.input: a page id and one sentence from that page
loop.output: a sentence kept only when that page states it
loop.check: The sentence cites a page id and the page text contains it.
loop.stop: Stop when there is no page id, or the page does not state the sentence. The engineer writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which sentence is absent from the held control, so it would present a rule the control does not state.

steps.what: Provide customers or installation teams the guidelines, and accept the text.
File the accepted guidelines for those secure systems.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store drafts a guideline sentence only when a held control page states it. The systems engineer provides that text to the customers or the installation team and accepts the version. The file stores only the accepted version. A sentence the control does not state is left for the engineer to write.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidelines were copied from an old system and still named controls that this one does not have.
tasks.enabler_now: A held control page can supply a sentence it actually states. The guideline still has to be accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Telling a customer what to do when the control page is silent stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer accepts the guidelines and speaks to the team. A quoted sentence is not that advice.
tasks.altitude: Guidelines are still accepted by the engineer before they are filed. Quoted control text is only a draft.

reach.task: State a control the organisation already holds.
reach.learn: A draft sentence is not the control decision.

evidence.claim: A sentence may be kept only when a page the company already holds states it. The draft is not the guideline.
Giving the guidelines to a customer or an installation team, and accepting the text, stays with the engineer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: A control page id and the sentence on that page. A sentence with no page is not kept. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the control page from the document store before writing a separate guideline file.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether customers and installation teams receive the same accepted text.
research_questions: Which control pages are allowed to be quoted into a guideline?

already_counted.description: Providing the guidelines and accepting the text stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop guideline sentences whose control page has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: guideline version and the control page ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still provides the guidelines and still accepts the text. The draft may repeat only a sentence a held control page states, and only that accepted version is filed. A page that does not state the rule saves none of the writing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the open analysis and development items already assigned.
Direct the analysis, development, and operation of complete computer systems.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} board shows analysis and development items already assigned. The systems engineer directs the analysis, the development, and the operation of the complete computer system. The list does not give that direction. An item with no owner is not assigned by the screen.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction was given in a corridor, and the board still showed last week's owner.
tasks.enabler_now: Assigned items can be shown. Directing the work still happens with the people doing it.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what the team does next, when two items compete, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer directs the work. The board is the list already assigned.
tasks.altitude: Direction of analysis, development, and operation stays with the engineer. The open list is only what was already assigned.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Test a change the engineer has already directed.
reach.learn: A board card is not the direction.

evidence.claim: Showing assigned items is a lookup of work already on the board. It does not direct the system.
Analysis, development, and operation are directed by the engineer with the people who do the work.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The work id and the items already assigned to it. New items are not created by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the project board before printing the same list again.
unknowns: Whether operation items sit on the same board as development items.
research_questions: Who receives direction when the assigned engineer is away?

already_counted.description: Directing the analysis, development, and operation stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Close items whose direction has already been given.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still directs analysis, development, and operation of the computer system. Only showing items that were already assigned is removed. A board with no owner saves none of that direction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The systems engineer still talks with staff, still recommends a component, and still directs the work. A stored request can be opened. It does not decide the system.
reach: Software developers write the change, and this job learns the requirement is heard from the people who use the system.
Network administrators run the live service, and this job learns a diagram is not the operation.
skills_to_grow: Hear the requirement from the person who does the work before writing it down.
Recommend a component only after the purpose it must serve is clear.
Direct development from the conversation, not from a status list.
role.ambitious_version: Requirements, component choices, and direction stay with the engineer. A stored request only shows what was already written.
